description: Use this only when a signed in customer clearly asks to pause, resume or cancel one of their teas.co.uk tea subscriptions; confirm which one and which change with them first. subscription_id is the id from my_subscriptions; ids from other accounts are never found. pause needs an active subscription, resume a paused one, and cancel works on either. Cancel is final: a cancelled subscription cannot be resumed here. An unknown id, or a change that does not fit the current status, returns an error and changes nothing. It returns the subscription as it is afterwards. To see the subscriptions first use my_subscriptions.

action.description: pause stops deliveries until resumed; resume restarts a paused subscription; cancel ends it, and a cancelled subscription cannot be resumed here.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A unique key for this change (8 to 128 letters, digits or . _ : -). Sending the same key again within 24 hours returns the first answer instead of making the change twice.

name: change_subscription
title: Change a subscription
